title: HRN Public view
description:
The Heat Relief Network is a regional partnership of the Maricopa Association of Governments (MAG), municipalities, nonprofit organizations, the faith-based community, and businesses. Each year, MAG coordinates the mapping of the Heat Relief Network, a network of partners providing water, cooling, and donation sites throughout the Valley with the goal of preventing heat-related illnesses and deaths among vulnerable populations. Locations are updated as new partners sign up throughout the summer season, which runs May 1st to September 30th. More information about the Heat Relief Network can be found here: Heat Relief Network

NOTE: This public view of the Heat Relief Network is updated daily to show only active sites and filtered hourly to check for active National Weather Service Excessive Heat Warnings or Watches in Maricopa County which would trigger a switch to extended hours for certain locations.
snippet: These data represent water collection/donation sites, cooling centers, respite centers and hydration stations for Summer 2026 heat relief efforts in Maricopa County, Arizona.

MAG cannot vouch for the authenticity or accuracy of all such sources and information provided may be subject to change as well. For those reasons, users of this data should independently verify, as needed, information provided herein. To the extent that any individual has a medical emergency in regard to heat-related issues, they should contact their doctor or call 9-1-1 immediately.
